title: DocumentSpecification
description: Document type definition, version 0.1.0. Aligned to TMF667 v5 DocumentSpecification. Configured per tenant (CM Mediator in production). Drives required metadata, retention, accepted file types and the extraction template for a type.

lifecycleStatus.x-tmf667: DocumentSpecification.lifecycleStatus (free string in TMF667; our vocabulary)

extractable.description: true = offered by extraction review with confidence.

alwaysReview.description: true = a person must accept or edit this field whatever its confidence; never included in bulk accept. Use for numbers, parties, dates, amounts.

reviewThreshold.description: Stricter per-field cut-off for High. Can tighten the tenant/master threshold, never loosen it.

retentionPolicyRef.x-extension: retention; periods are tenant and jurisdiction configuration, not model

businessProcess.description: The business processes this document type serves, from the TM Forum Business Process Framework (GB921). Always carries the release, because codes change between releases. Our judgement, not stated by eTOM; see docs/tmf667-mapping.md.

origin.description: Where this resolved definition comes from in the tenant hierarchy. Read-only: the seam returns the effective definition for the calling tenant (master merged with child). See tenant-policy.schema.json.

locked.description: true = the master forbids child changes to this definition.

overriddenFields.description: Fields the child changed relative to the master.

storesPersonalData.description: true triggers minimisation rules: outcome and fields only, original held by the provider (rule 6).
